tasks.prompt: You write a formal enquiry and know the name of the person (Ms Starr). Which salutation and close?
tasks.solution: Formal with name: Dear Ms Starr … Sincerely yours.

tasks.prompt: You don’t know the name of the person. Which salutation fits the exam enquiry?
tasks.solution: Unknown name: Dear Sales team … Kind/Best regards or Sincerely yours (formal).

options.text: Dear Sales team / Dear Bicycles Inc. team – Kind regards
To whom it may concern – Yours lovingly

tasks.prompt: What should the subject line of your exam email say?
tasks.solution: Always the precise subject: “Enquiry about your …”.

tasks.prompt: Read: structure of an enquiry email
tasks.solution: 1) Source of address (We have seen your advertisement… / We were impressed by your products at the trade fair…). 2) Describe your company (We are a leading importer/retailer/wholesaler of… / a medium-sized business with…). 3) Request (We are particularly interested in… / We would be grateful if you could send us… / Do you grant a quantity/initial order discount?). 4) Enclosures (Please find attached…). 5) Polite ending (If your goods meet our requirements, we will be in a position to place a substantial order. / We look forward to hearing from you soon.).

tasks.prompt: Translate: „Wir wären Ihnen dankbar, wenn Sie uns Informationen zu Ihrer Produktpalette schicken könnten.“
tasks.solution: We would be grateful if you could send us information on your product range.
tasks.rubric: Correct structure “would be grateful if you could”; product range.

tasks.prompt: Translate: „Gewähren Sie einen Mengenrabatt oder einen Erstauftragsrabatt?“
tasks.solution: Do you grant a quantity discount or an initial order discount?
tasks.rubric: grant; quantity discount; initial order discount.

tasks.prompt: Translate: „Wir waren von den Produkten, die Ihre Firma auf der letzten Handelsmesse vorgeführt hat, beeindruckt.“
tasks.solution: We were most impressed by the products your company demonstrated at the recent trade fair.

tasks.prompt: Translate: „Wir sind ein mittelständisches Unternehmen mit vielen langjährigen Kunden.“
tasks.solution: We are a medium-sized business with many longstanding customers.

tasks.prompt: Translate: „Wir würden es begrüßen, wenn Sie uns Ihre Zahlungs- und Lieferbedingungen schicken könnten.“
tasks.solution: We would appreciate it if you could send us your terms of payment and delivery.
tasks.rubric: would appreciate it if; terms of payment and delivery.

tasks.prompt: Which is the best polite ending for an enquiry?

options.text: We look forward to hearing from you soon.

tasks.prompt: Which sentence correctly refers to an attachment?

options.text: Find our catalogue is attached please.
Please find attached our online catalogue.

tasks.prompt: Which sentence is grammatically correct for a polite request?
tasks.solution: Exception to the if-rule: “would” in polite requests.

options.text: We would be pleased if you would send us a copy of your catalogue.
We are pleased if you would to send us a copy.
We will be pleased if you would sent us a copy.
We would be pleased if you will send us a copy.

tasks.prompt: Write an enquiry email (100–150 words): Your company Elek Elektronik GmbH saw ergonomic office chairs from Ubix Ltd at a trade fair. Ask for prices, discounts for an initial order of 20 chairs, and delivery terms.
tasks.solution: Subject: Enquiry about your office chairs. Dear Ubix Sales Team, At the recent trade fair in Hannover we were most impressed by your ergonomic office chairs. Elek Elektronik GmbH is a medium-sized electronics manufacturer with around 300 employees in Germany. As we are currently refurbishing our offices, we are particularly interested in your model … We would be grateful if you could send us your current price list. Do you grant a discount for an initial order of 20 chairs? Information on your terms of payment and delivery would also be appreciated. If your products meet our requirements, we will be in a position to place a substantial order. We look forward to hearing from you soon. Kind regards, [Name], Purchasing Manager
tasks.rubric: Correct layout (subject, salutation, close, name/title); source of address; company description; request incl. discount and terms; polite ending; formal register; correct grammar.
